topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I've been walking around in circles, looking at the ring, trying to understand how it got here. It's her ring, the one she wore on her left hand for as long as I can remember. The one she was never without. The pawn shop was crowded, but all I could see was this piece of her life sitting on a plush red velvet cushion, under the harsh fluorescent lights. I keep wondering, who brought it here? Did something happen to my family? My hands tremble as I stare at it, feeling like a stranger in a place I shouldn’t be.
